description: Engine refinements on top of the catalogue (DECISIONS D15-D18). Kept out of retrofit_catalogue.json so pipelines/build_catalogue.py never overwrites them.

boiler_efficiency_by_heating_rating.basis: EPC main-heating rating used as a proxy for boiler type: Very Good/Good ~ condensing, Average ~ non-condensing 1998+, Poor/Very Poor ~ older non-condensing or back boiler. Values approximate the SAP Table 4b default seasonal efficiencies (condensing ~84-89%, non-condensing 1998+ ~73-74%, pre-1998 ~65%); Good = 0.85 keeps the cat-v3 default.
boiler_efficiency_by_heating_rating.verify_against: SAP 10.2 Table 4b (BRE); values not checked against the table text in this build
boiler_efficiency_by_heating_rating.used_for: useful heat delivered by the existing boiler (heat-pump replacement electricity). Fabric and controls gas savings do not depend on it (the efficiency cancels).

electric_heating.efficiency_basis: direct-acting and storage electric heating deliver ~100% of the electricity as heat at the point of use (assumption)

segment_impacts.method: empirical Bayes: deviation of each segment median from the headline median, shrunk by w = tau^2 / (tau^2 + se^2); se of a median = 1.2533 x (IQR / 1.349) / sqrt(n); tau^2 = max(0, variance of segment deviations - mean se^2) per measure x dimension. Shrunken deviations of the home's segments (EPC band, age, type, region) are added to every impact level and the result is floored at 0.
segment_impacts.age_rule: midpoint of the EPC age band (single year for one-year bands; 'before 1900' = Pre 1919) placed in the first NEED band whose upper year it does not exceed
